def _iter_sse(response: Any) -> Iterator[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Parse a ``text/event-stream`` body into JSON event objects."""
    data_lines: List[str] = []
    for raw_line in response:
        if isinstance(raw_line, bytes):
            line = raw_line.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        else:
            line = str(raw_line)
        line = line.rstrip("'"\\r\\n\")
        if not line:
            if data_lines:
                chunk = \"\\n\".join(data_lines)
                data_lines = []
                if chunk.strip() == \"[DONE]\":
                    return
                try:
                    event = json.loads(chunk)
                except ValueError:
                    continue
                if isinstance(event, Mapping):
                    yield dict(event)
            continue
        if line.startswith(\":\"):
            continue
        if line.startswith(\"data:\"):
            data_lines.append(line[5:].lstrip())
    if data_lines:
        chunk = \"\\n\".join(data_lines)
        if chunk.strip() and chunk.strip() "'!= "[DONE]":
            try:
                event = json.loads(chunk)
            except ValueError:
                return
            if isinstance(event, Mapping):
                yield dict(event)

        status: Optional[int] = None,
        code: Optional[str] = None,
        error_type: Optional[str] = None,
        param: Optional[str] = None,
        request_id: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(message)
        self.message = message
        self.status = status
        self.code = code
        self.error_type = error_type
        self.param = param
        self.request_id = request_id

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        details = []
        if self.status is not None:
            details.append(f\"status={self.status}\")
        if self.code:
            details.append(f\"code={self.code}\")
        if self.error_type:
            details.append(f\"type={self.error_type}\")
        if self.param:
            details.append(f\"param={self.param}\")
        if self.request_id:
            details.append(f\"request_id={self.request_id}\")
        suffix = f\" ({', '.join(details)})\" if details else \"\"
        return f\"{self.message}{suffix}\"

    @classmethod
    def from_body(cls, status: Optional[int], body: bytes, headers: Optional[Mapping[str, str]] = None) -> \"APIStatusError\":
        text = body.decode(\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\") if body else \"\"
        message, code, error_type, param = \"\", None, None, None
        try:
            document = json.loads(text)
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            document = None
        if isinstance(document, Mapping):
            error = document.get(\"error\")
            if isinstance(error, Mapping):
                message = _clean_message(error.get(\"message\", \"\"))
                code = error.get(\"code\")
                error_type = error.get(\"type\")
                param = error.get(\"param\")
            elif \"message\" in document:
                message = _clean_message(document.get(\"message\"))
            elif \"detail\" in document:
                message = _clean_message(document.get(\"detail\"))
        if not message:
            snippet = redact_secrets(\" \".join(text.split()))[:300]
            message = snippet or f\"HTTP {status} with empty response body\"
        request_id = None
        if headers:
            request_id = headers.get(\"x-request-id\") or headers.get(\"X-Request-Id\")
        return cls(message, status=status, code=code, error_type=error_type, param=param, request_id=request_id)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Usage:
    \"\"\"Token accounting reported by the API.\"\"\"

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ResponseResult:
    \"\"\"A completed (or terminal) Responses API object, plus its plain text.\"\"\"

    id: str = \"\"
    status: str = \"\"
    model: str = \"\"
    output_text: str = \"\"
    usage: Usage = field(default_factory=Usage)
    created_at: Optional[int] = None
    incomplete_details: Optional[Mapping[str, Any]] = None
    error: Optional[Mapping[str, Any]] = None
    raw: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, document: Mapping[str, Any]) -> \"ResponseResult\":
        if not isinstance(document, Mapping):
            raise OpenAIClientError(\"Response payload was not a JSON object\")
        return cls(
            id=str(document.get(\"id\") or \"\"),
            status=str(document.get(\"status\") or \"\"),
            model=str(document.get(\"model\") or \"\"),
            output_text=extract_output_text(document.get(\"output\")),
            usage=Usage.from_dict(document.get(\"usage\")),
            created_at=document.get(\"created_at\"),
            incomplete_details=document.get(\"incomplete_details\") if isinstance(document.get(\"incomplete_details\"), Mapping) else None,
            error=document.get(\"error\") if isinstance(document.get(\"error\"), Mapping) else None,
            raw=dict(document),
        )

    def raise_for_status(self) -> \"ResponseResult\":
        \"\"\"Raise if the API marked the response failed.\"\"\"
        if self.status == \"failed\":
            detail = self.error or {}
            raise APIStatusError(
                _clean_message(detail.get(\"message\") or \"Response failed\"),
                code=detail.get(\"code\"),
                error_type=detail.get(\"type\"),
                request_id=self.id or None,
            )
        return self


def extract_output_text(output: Any) -> str:
    \"\"\"Pull the assistant text out of a Responses API "'``output`` array."""
    if output is None:
        return ""
    if isinstance(output, str):
        return output
    if not isinstance(output, Sequence):
        return ""
    messages: List[str] = []
    for item in output:
        if not isinstance(item, Mapping):
            continue
        item_type = item.get("type")
        if item_type == "message":
            chunks = []
            for part in item.get("content") or []:
                if isinstance(part, Mapping) and part.get("type") in ("output_text", "text"):
                    chunks.append(part.get("text") or "")
            if chunks:
                messages.append("".join(chunks))
        elif item_type in ("output_text", "text") and item.get("text"):
            messages.append(str(item.get("text")))
    return "'"\\n\".join(messages)


class _Opener:
    \"\"\"Thin wrapper around "'``urllib.request`` that always verifies TLS."""

    def __init__(self, ssl_context: Optional[ssl.SSLContext] = None) -> None:
        self._context = ssl_context or ssl.create_default_context()
        self._opener = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPSHandler(context=self._context))

    def open(self, request: urllib.request.Request, timeout: float) -> Any:
        return self._opener.open(request, timeout=timeout)


class ResponsesClient:
    """Send text prompts to ``POST /v1/responses`` with privacy-friendly defaults."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        api_key: [REDACTED_SECRET] = None,
        *,
        model: Optional[str] = None,
        base_url: Optional[str] = None,
        organization: Optional[str] = None,
        project: Optional[str] = None,
        timeout: float = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT,
        max_retries: int = DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES,
        store: bool = False,
        instructions: Optional[str] = None,
        prompt_cache_key: Optional[str] = None,
        safety_identifier: Optional[str] = None,
        ephemeral_cache_key: bool = True,
        ssl_context: Optional[ssl.SSLContext] = None,
        opener: Optional[Any] = None,
    ) -> None:
        resolved_key = api_key or os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY") or ""
        resolved_key = resolved_key.strip()
        if not resolved_key:
            raise ConfigurationError(
                "No API key found. Pass api_key=... or export OPENAI_API_KEY."
            )
        self._api_key = resolved_key

        resolved_base = base_url or os.environ.get("OPENAI_BASE_URL") or DEFAULT_BASE_URL
        self.base_url = resolved_base.rstrip("/")
        self.model = model or os.environ.get("OPENAI_MODEL") or DEFAULT_MODEL
        self.organization = organization or os.environ.get("OPENAI_ORGANIZATION")
        self.project = project or os.environ.get("OPENAI_PROJECT")
        self.timeout = float(timeout)
        self.max_retries = max(0, int(max_retries))
        self.store = bool(store)
        self.instructions = instructions
        self.safety_identifier = safety_identifier

        if prompt_cache_key is not None:
            self.prompt_cache_key: Optional[str] = prompt_cache_key
        elif ephemeral_cache_key:
            self.prompt_cache_key = f"eph-{uuid.uuid4().hex}"
        else:
            self.prompt_cache_key = None

        self._opener = opener or _Opener(ssl_context=ssl_context)

    def _headers(self, *, streaming: bool) -> Dict[str, str]:
        headers = {
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {self._api_key}",
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            "Accept": "text/event-stream" if streaming else "application/json",
            "User-Agent": USER_AGENT,
        }
        if self.organization:
            headers["OpenAI-Organization"] = self.organization
        if self.project:
            headers["OpenAI-Project"] = self.project
        return headers

    def _payload(
        self,
        input_value: InputValue,
        options: Mapping[str, Any],
        *,
        stream: bool,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        payload: Dict[str, Any] = {"model": self.model, "input": input_value}
        candidates: Dict[str, Any] = {
            "instructions": options.get("instructions", self.instructions),
            "max_output_tokens": options.get("max_output_tokens"),
            "temperature": options.get("temperature"),
            "top_p": options.get("top_p"),
            "reasoning": options.get("reasoning"),
            "text": options.get("text"),
            "tools": options.get("tools"),
            "tool_choice": options.get("tool_choice"),
            "parallel_tool_calls": options.get("parallel_tool_calls"),
            "previous_response_id": options.get("previous_response_id"),
            "truncation": options.get("truncation"),
            "metadata": options.get("metadata"),
            "include": options.get("include"),
            "service_tier": options.get("service_tier"),
            "background": options.get("background"),
            "prompt_cache_key": options.get("prompt_cache_key", self.prompt_cache_key),
            "safety_identifier": options.get("safety_identifier", self.safety_identifier),
        }
        store = options.get("store", self.store)
        payload["store"] = bool(store)
        for key, value in candidates.items():
            if value is not None:
                payload[key] = value
        if stream:
            payload["stream"] = True
        extra_body = options.get("extra_body")
        if isinstance(extra_body, Mapping):
            payload.update({k: v for k, v in extra_body.items() if v is not None})
        model_override = options.get("model")
        if model_override:
            payload["model"] = model_override
        return payload

    def _request(self, input_value: InputValue, options: Mapping[str, Any], *, stream: bool) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        payload = self._payload(input_value, options, stream=stream)
        body = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
        request = urllib.request.Request(
            f"{self.base_url}/responses",
            data=body,
            headers=self._headers(streaming=stream),
            method="POST",
        )
        timeout = float(options.get("timeout") or self.timeout)
        response = self._send(request, timeout=timeout)
        raw = response.read()
        status = getattr(response, "status", None) or getattr(response, "code", 200)
        if status and int(status) >= 400:
            raise APIStatusError.from_body(int(status), raw, getattr(response, "headers", None))
        try:
            document = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"))
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise OpenAIClientError(f"Could not parse API response as JSON: {exc}") from exc
        if not isinstance(document, Mapping):
            raise OpenAIClientError("API response was not a JSON object")
        return document

    def _send(self, request: urllib.request.Request, *, timeout: float) -> Any:
        attempt = 0
        while True:
            try:
                return self._opener.open(request, timeout=timeout)
            except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
                body = b""
                try:
                    body = exc.read()
                except Exception:
                    body = b""
                headers = exc.headers or {}
                if exc.code in RETRYABLE_STATUS and attempt < self.max_retries:
                    time.sleep(self._delay_for(attempt, headers.get("Retry-After") if hasattr(headers, "get") else None))
                    attempt += 1
                    continue
                raise APIStatusError.from_body(exc.code, body, headers) from None
            except urllib.error.URLError as exc:
                reason = exc.reason
                if attempt < self.max_retries and isinstance(reason, RETRYABLE_TRANSPORT):
                    time.sleep(self._delay_for(attempt, None))
                    attempt += 1
                    continue
                raise OpenAIClientError(f"Could not reach {request.full_url}: {_clean_message(reason)}") from None
            except RETRYABLE_TRANSPORT as exc:
                if attempt < self.max_retries:
                    time.sleep(self._delay_for(attempt, None))
                    attempt += 1
                    continue
                raise OpenAIClientError(f"Request to {request.full_url} failed: {_clean_message(exc)}") from None

    @staticmethod
    def _delay_for(attempt: int, retry_after: Optional[str]) -> float:
        header_delay = _parse_retry_after(retry_after)
        if header_delay is not None:
            return min(header_delay, MAX_RETRY_DELAY)
        backoff = min(MAX_RETRY_DELAY, 0.5 * (2 ** attempt))
        return backoff + random.uniform(0, backoff * 0.2)

    def create(
        self,
        input_value: InputValue,
        *,
        model: Optional[str] = None,
        instructions: Optional[str] = None,
        max_output_tokens: Optional[int] = None,
        temperature: Optional[float] = None,
        top_p: Optional[float] = None,
        reasoning: Optional[Mapping[str, Any]] = None,
        reasoning_effort: Optional[str] = None,
        text: Optional[Mapping[str, Any]] = None,
        tools: Optional[Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]] = None,
        tool_choice: Optional[Any] = None,
        parallel_tool_calls: Optional[bool] = None,
        previous_response_id: Optional[str] = None,
        truncation: Optional[str] = None,
        metadata: Optional[Mapping[str, str]] = None,
        include: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None,
        service_tier: Optional[str] = None,
        background: Optional[bool] = None,
        store: Optional[bool] = None,
        prompt_cache_key: Optional[str] = None,
        safety_identifier: Optional[str] = None,
        extra_body: Optional[Mapping[str, Any]] = None,
        timeout: Optional[float] = None,
    ) -> ResponseResult:
        """Create a response and return it as a ``ResponseResult``."""
        if reasoning is None and reasoning_effort:
            reasoning = {"effort": reasoning_effort}
        options: Dict[str, Any] = {
            "model": model,
            "instructions": instructions,
            "max_output_tokens": max_output_tokens,
            "temperature": temperature,
            "top_p": top_p,
            "reasoning": reasoning,
            "text": text,
            "tools": tools,
            "tool_choice": tool_choice,
            "parallel_tool_calls": parallel_tool_calls,
            "previous_response_id": previous_response_id,
            "truncation": truncation,
            "metadata": metadata,
            "include": include,
            "service_tier": service_tier,
            "background": background,
            "store": store,
            "prompt_cache_key": prompt_cache_key,
            "safety_identifier": safety_identifier,
            "extra_body": extra_body,
            "timeout": timeout,
        }
        document = self._request(input_value, options, stream=False)
        return ResponseResult.from_dict(document).raise_for_status()

    def ask(self, prompt: str, **kwargs: Any) -> str:
        """Send a single text prompt and return the assistant text."""
        if not isinstance(prompt, str) or not prompt.strip():
            raise OpenAIClientError("Prompt must be a non-empty string")
        return self.create(prompt, **kwargs).output_text

    def stream(self, input_value: InputValue, **kwargs: Any) -> Iterator[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Yield server-sent events for a streaming response.

        Text deltas arrive as ``response.output_text.delta`` events. Terminal
        ``response.failed`` or ``error`` events raise ``APIStatusError``.
        """
        options = dict(kwargs)
        options.pop("stream", None)
        payload = self._payload(input_value, options, stream=True)
        body = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
        request = urllib.request.Request(
            f"{self.base_url}/responses",
            data=body,
            headers=self._headers(streaming=True),
            method="POST",
        )
        timeout = float(options.get("timeout") or self.timeout)
        response = self._send(request, timeout=timeout)
        try:
            for event in _iter_sse(response):
                event_type = event.get("type")
                if event_type == "error":
                    detail = event.get("error") if isinstance(event.get("error"), Mapping) else event
                    raise APIStatusError(
                        _clean_message(detail.get("message") or "Streaming error"),
                        code=detail.get("code"),
                        error_type=detail.get("type"),
                    )
                if event_type == "response.failed":
                    failed = event.get("response") if isinstance(event.get("response"), Mapping) else {}
                    detail = failed.get("error") if isinstance(failed.get("error"), Mapping) else {}
                    raise APIStatusError(
                        _clean_message(detail.get("message") or "Response failed while streaming"),
                        code=detail.get("code"),
                        error_type=detail.get("type"),
                    )
                yield event
        finally:
            close = getattr(response, "close", None)
            if callable(close):
                close()

    def stream_text(self, prompt: str, **kwargs: Any) -> Iterator[str]:
        """Yield only the incremental assistant text for a prompt."""
        for event in self.stream(prompt, **kwargs):
            if event.get("type") in TEXT_DELTA_EVENTS:
                delta = event.get("delta")
                if delta:
                    yield delta

    def collect_stream(self, prompt: str, **kwargs: Any) -> ResponseResult:
        """Stream a prompt, discard the events, and return the final result."""
        final: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
        pieces: List[str] = []
        for event in self.stream(prompt, **kwargs):
            event_type = event.get("type")
            if event_type in TEXT_DELTA_EVENTS and event.get("delta"):
                pieces.append(event["delta"])
            elif event_type in TERMINAL_EVENTS and isinstance(event.get("response"), Mapping):
                final = event["response"]
        if final is None:
            return ResponseResult(output_text="".join(pieces), status="completed")
        result = ResponseResult.from_dict(final)
        if not result.output_text and pieces:
            result = ResponseResult(
                id=result.id,
                status=result.status,
                model=result.model,
                output_text="".join(pieces),
                usage=result.usage,
                created_at=result.created_at,
                incomplete_details=result.incomplete_details,
                error=result.error,
                raw=result.raw,
            )
        return result.raise_for_status()

    def close(self) -> None:
        """No persistent connections are kept, so this is a no-op hook."""
        return None

    def __enter__(self) -> "ResponsesClient":
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *exc_info: Any) -> None:
        self.close()


def _iter_sse(response: Any) -> Iterator[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Parse a ``text/event-stream`` body into JSON event objects."""
    data_lines: List[str] = []
    for raw_line in response:
        if isinstance(raw_line, bytes):
            line = raw_line.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        else:
            line = str(raw_line)
        line = line.rstrip("'"\\r\\n\")
        if not line:
            if data_lines:
                chunk = \"\\n\".join(data_lines)
                data_lines = []
                if chunk.strip() == \"[DONE]\":
                    return
                try:
                    event = json.loads(chunk)
                except ValueError:
                    continue
                if isinstance(event, Mapping):
                    yield dict(event)
            continue
        if line.startswith(\":\"):
            continue
        if line.startswith(\"data:\"):
            data_lines.append(line[5:].lstrip())
    if data_lines:
        chunk = \"\\n\".join(data_lines)
        if chunk.strip() and chunk.strip() "'!= "[DONE]":
            try:
                event = json.loads(chunk)
            except ValueError:
                return
            if isinstance(event, Mapping):
                yield dict(event)


def _build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="openai_client.py",
        description="Send a private text prompt to the OpenAI Responses API (standard library only).",
        formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter,
        epilog=(
            "Privacy: prompts are sent over TLS only, responses are not stored server-side'"\\n\"
            \"unless --store is given, and nothing is written to disk by this tool.\\n\"
            \"With no prompt argument and no piped input, the prompt is read with hidden input.\\n\"
        ),
    )
    parser.add_argument(\"prompt\", nargs=\"?\", help=\"Prompt text, or '-' to read stdin.\")
    parser.add_argument(\"-m\", \"--model\", help=f\"Model id (default: env OPENAI_MODEL or {DEFAULT_MODEL}).\")
    parser.add_argument(\"--base-url\", help=f\"API base URL (default: env OPENAI_BASE_URL or {DEFAULT_BASE_URL}).\")
    parser.add_argument(\"--instructions\", help=\"System-style instructions for this request only.\")
    parser.add_argument(\"--max-output-tokens\", type=int, help=\"Cap on generated output tokens.\")
    parser.add_argument(\"--temperature\", type=float, help=\"Sampling temperature.\")
    parser.add_argument(\"--top-p\", type=float, help=\"Nucleus sampling parameter.\")
    parser.add_argument(\"--reasoning-effort\", choices=[\"minimal\", \"low\", \"medium\", \"high\"], help=\"Reasoning effort.\")
    parser.add_argument(\"--previous-response-id\", help=\"Chain onto a stored response (requires --store on both calls).\")
    parser.add_argument(\"--metadata\", action=\"append\", default=[], metavar=\"KEY=VALUE\", help=\"Attach metadata; repeatable.\")
    parser.add_argument(\"--store\", action=\"store_true\", help=\"Allow the API to store this response (default: not stored).\")
    parser.add_argument(\"--no-cache-key\", action=\"store_true\", help=\"Omit the random prompt_cache_key.\")
    parser.add_argument(\"--cache-key\", help=\"Use an explicit prompt_cache_key instead of the random one.\")
    parser.add_argument(\"--safety-identifier\", help=\"Optional end-user identifier for abuse detection.\")
    parser.add_argument(\"-s\", \"--stream\", action=\"store_true\", help=\"Stream text deltas to stdout as they arrive.\")
    parser.add_argument(\"--json\", action=\"store_true\", help=\"Print the raw response JSON instead of just the text.\")
    parser.add_argument(\"--usage\", action=\"store_true\", help=\"Print token usage to stderr after the reply.\")
    parser.add_argument(\"--timeout\", type=float, default=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT, help=\"Per-request timeout in seconds.\")
    parser.add_argument(\"--max-retries\", type=int, default=DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES, help=\"Retries for 429/5xx and transport errors.\")
    parser.add_argument(\"-q\", \"--quiet\", action=\"store_true\", help=\"Suppress progress notes on stderr.\")
    parser.add_argument(\"--version\", action=\"version\", version=f\"%(prog)s {__version__}\")
    return parser


def _parse_metadata(pairs: Sequence[str]) -> Optional[Dict[str, str]]:
    if not pairs:
        return None
    metadata: Dict[str, str] = {}
    for pair in pairs:
        if \"=\" not in pair:
            raise ConfigurationError(f\"--metadata expects KEY=VALUE, got {pair"'!r}")
        key, value = pair.split("=", 1)
        metadata[key.strip()] = value
    return metadata


def _read_prompt(argument: Optional[str]) -> str:
    if argument is not None and argument != "-":
        return argument
    if argument == "-" or not sys.stdin.isatty():
        data = sys.stdin.read()
        if data.strip():
            return data.strip()
        if argument == "-":
            raise ConfigurationError("No prompt provided on stdin.")
    return getpass.getpass("Prompt (input hidden): ")


def main(argv: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None) -> int:
    parser = _build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    try:
        prompt = _read_prompt(args.prompt)
    except (EOFError, KeyboardInterrupt):
        print("", file=sys.stderr)
        return 130
    if not prompt.strip():
        print("error: empty prompt", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    try:
        client = ResponsesClient(
            model=args.model,
            base_url=args.base_url,
            timeout=args.timeout,
            max_retries=args.max_retries,
            store=args.store,
            instructions=args.instructions,
            prompt_cache_key=args.cache_key,
            safety_identifier=args.safety_identifier,
            ephemeral_cache_key=not args.no_cache_key and args.cache_key is None,
        )
    except ConfigurationError as exc:
        print(f"error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    kwargs: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "max_output_tokens": args.max_output_tokens,
        "temperature": args.temperature,
        "top_p": args.top_p,
        "reasoning_effort": args.reasoning_effort,
        "previous_response_id": args.previous_response_id,
        "metadata": _parse_metadata(args.metadata),
    }
    kwargs = {key: value for key, value in kwargs.items() if value is not None}

    if not args.quiet:
        note = "stored server-side" if args.store else "not stored server-side"
        print(f"model={client.model} stream={str(bool(args.stream)).lower()} response={note}", file=sys.stderr)

    try:
        if args.stream:
            result = client.collect_stream(prompt, **kwargs)
        else:
            result = client.create(prompt, **kwargs)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("", file=sys.stderr)
